# Invariants visible in the code

> Draft generated by reading the code — **not approved documentation**.

- A booking always names a quote — `Booking.quote_id` has no default (`harbourline/bookings.py`).
- A sailing is never booked beyond its capacity in kilograms (`harbourline/capacity.py`).
- The chargeable weight is never below the actual weight (`pricing/freight.py`).
